✅ Launch Readiness Checklist

Pre-Launch Essentials

  • Launch tier defined (Tier 1/2/3) with corresponding resource allocation
  • Positioning and messaging approved by stakeholders
  • Sales enablement materials ready (pitch deck, battlecard, FAQ)
  • Content calendar aligned with launch date
  • PR/AR briefing schedule confirmed
  • Demo environment and customer references ready
  • Success metrics defined and tracking in place
